definition: Standing-equivalent anatomical body height = top of cranium without ponytail to base of neck, plus neck-to-pelvis along the unbent torso, plus an unfolded hip/knee/ankle/plantar-sole chain. No silhouette bbox, hair extent, raised hand, airborne displacement or forward toe projection.
method: Visually measured from native source sheets and cross-checked between adjacent phases. Manual approximations, not automatically inferred bone lengths. Values deliberately rounded to 5px.
estimated_error: Approximately ±5% on upright poses and ±8% or more on prone/rotated/foreshortened poses. Avoid converting the uncertainty into frame-to-frame scaling jitter.

idle.description: Standing frame 1 anatomical crown (not ponytail) through neck and pelvis; continue down the less-foreshortened bent supporting leg through knee, ankle and plantar sole. Other frames are visually same-scale.

jump.description: Use extended takeoff frame 2 as principal ruler and cross-check the pelvis-to-knee-to-ankle chain in crouch/apex frames after unfolding. Raised arms and lifted feet do not enter ruler.
jump.registration: Use one ruler; small apparent segment changes in tucked frames are largely foreshortening, not reliable evidence for rescaling.

hurt.description: Crown-to-neck plus the unbent torso/spine from flinch frame 1 and guarded frame 2; unfolded thigh/shin/sole, cross-checked against recovery frame 6. Do not shrink the hunched frames to their shorter screen-height.
hurt.registration: One ruler is sufficient; low-confidence per-frame fluctuation under about 5% is not worth introducing scale jitter.

down.description: Frame 1 uses upright head/neck, neck/pelvis and longer extended leg. Later frames follow rotated neck-to-pelvis and unfold the longer visible leg; count ankle-to-plantar-sole thickness rather than the forward toe projection. Frame 6 about 65 + 150 + 235 = 450px.
down.registration: Per-frame rulers recommended. Late horizontal poses are about 5–6% smaller than the initial standing-equivalent drawing, beyond just pose compression.

recovering.description: Frame 1 MUST reuse actual down6 crop and its 450px ruler/root. Elbow/palm/kneel/crouch frames use crown-neck, rotated torso and unfolded visible thigh/shin chain. Standing frame 6 is about 85 + 180 + 285 = 550px, distinctly larger than the early prone poses.
recovering.registration: Per-frame rulers required. Do not use frame 6 standing screen-height as one ruler for every pose; that would leave the opening prone character undersized. The native generated recovery1 estimate is not used once down6 is substituted.

launched.description: On native 1774×887 source, measure crown-to-neck along tilted head, torso to pelvis and one unfolded thigh/knee/shin/ankle/sole chain; airborne translation, hair, open arms and extended toes are excluded.
launched.registration: One 500px ruler is the conservative recommendation. Frames 4–5 may be about 3–5% larger (rough ruler 515–525), but rotation/foreshortening uncertainty is comparable. Only use per-frame tuning after a same-scale overlay shows a visible bump.

stunned.description: Use frame 1 neck/pelvis and the less-foreshortened supporting leg, cross-check frame 6 upright torso. For forehead-clutch frames unfold knees/torso; do not count high ponytail or hand on crown as body height.
